title: Central Limit Theorems for Optimal Transport Functionals
abstract: arXiv:2610.27857v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We establish central limit theorems for empirical plug-in estimators of scalar functionals of quadratic optimal transport maps and potentials, including Wasserstein costs and several risk measures constructed from transport-based multivariate quantiles. We study the one-sample problem with a known reference distribution and i.i.d. observations from the target distribution. A natural approach is to combine a limit theorem for the empirical transport map with the functional delta method. We show, however, that in dimensions at least two, empirical transport-map errors admit no nonzero weak limit in $L^2$ under any normalizing scale. Instead, we linearize the functional directly in the target distribution, obtaining an influence-function expansion with a remainder controlled by the transport-map error. translated_title: 最优传输泛函的中心极限定理
translated_abstract: 我们为二次最优传输映射和势函数的标量泛函建立了经验代入估计量的中心极限定理，其中包括 Wasserstein 代价以及由基于传输的多变量分位数构造的若干风险度量。我们研究的是一个单样本问题：参考分布已知，观测样本独立同分布地来自目标分布。一种自然的方法是将经验传输映射的极限定理与函数 delta 方法相结合。然而，我们证明，在维数至少为 2 时，无论采用何种正规化尺度，经验传输映射误差在 $L^2$ 中都不存在非零弱极限。因此，我们转而直接在目标分布处对泛函进行线性化，得到一个影响函数展开，其余项由传输映射误差控制。该影响函数由一个线性椭圆偏微分方程刻画。在正则性条件下，我们利用这一展开……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文克服了经验传输映射误差在维数≥2时不存在 $L^2$ 非零弱极限的障碍，通过直接在目标分布处线性化泛函（影响函数由线性椭圆偏微分方程刻画），建立了 Wasserstein 代价等最优传输标量泛函代入估计量的中心极限定理。
en_tdlr: The paper establishes central limit theorems for plug-in estimators of optimal transport functionals (such as Wasserstein costs) by directly linearizing the functional via an influence-function expansion characterized by a linear elliptic PDE, thereby circumventing the fact that empirical transport-map errors admit no nonzero weak limit in $L^2$ in dimensions at least two.
